item.text:
**8B.4 Research Note**

Overall: **lean positive, mixed confidence**. In 2024 Kishida repeatedly used expert panels, formal councils, and rule changes to staff policy with technocrats and institutional actors, but LDP factional politics and survival bargaining still constrained how merit-based the governing network was.

**Positive**
- [Policy Speech by Prime Minister Kishida to the 213th Session of the Diet](https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/statement/202401/30shiseihoshin.html) | Prime Minister’s Office of Japan | 2024-01-30 | Kishida said party groups had to part completely with money and personnel matters, launched the Political Reform Headquarters, and told the Diet to turn 2024 priorities into concrete action; this is strong evidence he tried to empower rule-bound implementers over factional brokers. QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.3, 8B.2
- [Press Conference by Prime Minister Kishida](https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/statement/202406/21kaiken.html) | Prime Minister’s Office of Japan | 2024-06-21 | He said the reform HQ had pushed amendments to political-funds rules and a third-party inspections-and-audits body, showing he was building oversight capacity through institutions rather than personal networks. QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.3, 8B.2
- [GX 2040 Leaders Panel](https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/actions/202407/02gx_leaders.html) | Prime Minister’s Office of Japan | 2024-07-02 | Kishida brought business leaders, energy/technology experts, and cabinet members together to design long-horizon GX and industrial strategy, a direct example of empowering specialists to execute the program. QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.3, 8B.2
- [Prime Minister’s Office statement on active cyber defense](https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/actions/202406/07cyber.html) | Prime Minister’s Office of Japan | 2024-06-07 | He convened a 17-expert panel and asked ministers to turn its output into bills, which is a concrete technocratic implementation chain. QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.3, 8B.2
- [Liaison Meeting of the Government and Ruling Parties](https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/actions/202407/03sei_yoto.html) | Prime Minister’s Office of Japan | 2024-07-03 | Kishida said nearly all bills and treaties passed, including child-care and agriculture measures, and credited the government-ruling-party coalition, suggesting he could mobilize capable legislative and party actors effectively. QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.3

**Negative / Mixed**
- [LDP agrees to amend rules to strengthen governance amid funds scandal](https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2024/03/62a74c2cb396-ldp-agrees-to-amend-rules-to-strengthen-governance-amid-funds-scandal.html?phrase=number+of+vaccinated&words=) | Kyodo News | 2024-03-07 | The article says the party needed to move away from factions as vehicles for securing funds and allocating key posts, which is direct evidence that Kishida still governed inside a factional personnel system rather than a clean meritocracy. QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.3
- [Prosecutors indict several LDP faction members over funds scandal](https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2024/01/f4d6ea5b7d8f-update1-prosecutors-indict-several-ldp-faction-members-over-funds-scandal.html) | Kyodo News | 2024-01-19 | Prosecutors indicted people in Kishida’s factional orbit over undisclosed revenue, including figures with ministerial experience, showing opaque money and faction ties still shaped who had influence and access. QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.3
- [Japan’s legacy piece on Kishida](https://apnews.com/article/05926b50f4f5a83a631f779d906cf06d) | Associated Press | 2024-09-30 | AP said Kishida compromised with conservative nationalists to stay in power; that is mixed evidence that coalition survival needs still shaped who he empowered, even if it does not prove outright cronyism. QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.3
- [Freedom in the World 2024: Japan](https://freedomhouse.org/country/japan/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | Freedom House flags close government-business relations and lingering party-scandal problems, which is structural evidence that elite access and non-meritocratic networks still mattered. QIDs: 8B.4, 8B.3

**Search gap**
- Direct 2024 evidence of specific merit-based personnel decisions is limited. The strongest material is about expert panels, formal councils, and party-rule changes, not a clean cabinet-appointment audit.
- I did not find a 2024 source showing a major reshuffle that clearly replaced loyalists with technocrats at scale. That keeps this lens positive but not decisive.
